method: Use the project’s existing g_self_citation implementation at its default seed 2, with the public ZL practice training pages as its only input for word and glyph weights. Its initial stock is five draws from the 200 most frequent training forms, and each output copies uniformly from up to the last 40 items and makes zero, one, one or two attempts at a glyph change in EVA-basic. Replacement, insertion and deletion use the existing thresholds and learned marginal glyph frequencies. Run it on one dummy page of 1,000 rows of 12 placeholder slots, so it never resets its memory or reads an actual line number, paragraph position or page identity inside its loop. Concatenate the outputs and let the scorer put the continuous stream into the manuscript line layout. Freeze the sampler settings and use seed 2 unless rejected by screening of markers and all contiguous four-word sequences, including those spanning transport rows. Seed 2 passed the guard before any scoring of the sample. There is no edit targeting a line or its place on the page. Public controls independently permute the same stock within page, with and without fixed lengths at every slot.

public_practice.interpretation: Both page-matched controls fail, including the one holding every token length in place. The continuous ordered process passes with the same public layout. Its generated words average 15.22 transliteration characters, versus 4.92 for certain paragraph words in the public evaluation sample. The attack probes the power of this one comparator; it does not model the manuscript’s full set of properties.
public_practice.shuffle_method: Use seed 408 within the public placement. Shuffle only paragraph-token slots on each page, leaving all other slots and the unused tail untouched. For the length-matched shuffle, restrict exchanges within a page to equal transliteration character lengths. The selected page vocabularies and line lengths are preserved in both conditions.
